versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Huawei Cloud MRS HDFS performance issue analysis skill.
- Guides users through a three-stage diagnosis pipeline: alarm confirmation, quick check, and automated log deep analysis.
- Built-in Python analyzer extracts key performance metrics and log signals, generates 11 HTML trend charts, and produces an analysis summary.
- Supports root cause localization for HDFS slowness, RPC latency, NameNode GC alarms, and related performance issues.
- Provides detailed quick-check commands and troubleshooting for both alarm and non-alarm scenarios.
- Includes scenario-based knowledge base and comprehensive trigger keywords for precise activation.
